people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Rehoboam
people.line: Son of Solomon, first king of Judah

translations.web: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned Yahweh’s law, and all Israel with him.
translations.bsb: After Rehoboam had established his sovereignty and royal power, he and all Israel with him forsook the Law of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when the kingdom of Rehoboam was established, and he was strong, that he forsook the law of Jehovah, and all Israel with him.
